title: Buses for the Night Shift
transcript: The city will start running two late-night bus routes next month. Both buses will leave the central railway station every hour from midnight until four in the morning. The transport department introduced the service after local hospital workers said they had difficulty getting home after their shifts. Regular bus tickets will be accepted, and passengers will be able to track the vehicles on the city's travel app. The routes will be reviewed after six months.

questions.prompt: Whose comments helped bring about the service?
questions.explanation: 医院员工反映深夜下班后回家困难，促成了服务。
